assumptions.G2: BUILT (V4.1 MoE on the GPU pipeline: VRAM mirrors, prefetch, copy worker, RAM record cache) -- team 3 assumption; not in KAIRA src (ref:123-126)
assumptions.W2: BUILT (per-layer batched WNR decode) -- team 3 assumption; NOT in src (ref:127-135). No-W2 rows = sensitivity
assumptions.decode_cost: ceil-form formats use WNR2 decode costs (dk = 0) in the primary runs; ceil-gpu measured CF5/CF0 median +0.3..+1.7%, max +3.4% (RTX 3070, deferred patch) -> sensitivity dk = 0.034, and 0.157 = naive per-block byte store (CF/CF0 m3 median)
assumptions.record_sizes: ceil-ref real rANS records, 40 odd-indexed held-out experts (one per layer), models from the 80 even experts; applied as a paired byte delta to production WNR2 16,914,680 B; per MC draw a bootstrap resample of the 40 experts
assumptions.value_exact: WNR3z (canonical zero) is value-exact, not byte-exact: needs the logprob check (brief:13, 26)
assumptions.other: all other parameters, ranges, seeds (MC rng 7, D=400, T=40; center rng 20261107, 3000 tokens) are team 3's, unchanged

WNR2.description: production WNR2, 16,914,680 B mean over all 7680 records (measured)

WNR3.description: WNR3 byte-exact = f+g+d+e (g = densest-pair anchor as defined by team 3)

WNR3t.description: WNR3 byte-exact with tail seeding instead of the hash = f+g+d+t

WNR3_g0.description: as WNR3 but constant srel anchor 120 (g0)

WNR3zt_est.description: ESTIMATE (not encoded): fgcd + per-expert tail-seeding increment (fgdt - fgd)

T3_WNR3.description: team 3's entropy-based WNR3 estimate (a+b+d+e), for comparison

T3_WNR3z.description: team 3's entropy-based WNR3z estimate (a+b+c+d+e), for comparison
